All 7 legacy verbs warn exactly once and TERMLINK_NO_DEPRECATION_WARN=1 suppresses (checked on paths that reach the helper). Two replacement hints are wrong: (1) file send says 'termlink channel post --file' but channel post has no --file flag (and the T-1166 migration guide says to keep using file send/receive); (2) targeted event broadcast says 'event emit_to' but the verb is 'emit-to'. Fix file.rs:185 and events.rs:280. Also fix the AC steps: 'remote push x --message x' and 'event broadcast topic-x payload' fail clap parsing before the helper runs, so the step-4 suppression check prints 0 for that reason, not because of suppression. Use 'remote push 127.0.0.1:1 x --message x --secret <64hex>' and 'event broadcast topic-x --payload notjson'.

Footer shows '1 of 2 peer(s) active in window=86400s': both numbers present, but it reads as 'only 1 of 2 peers was active' (false: both were active). Make the truncation explicit, e.g. 'showing top 1 of 2 peer(s) active in window=86400s' or '2 peer(s) active in window=86400s (showing top 1)'.

All four Expected items met (clear per tick, aligned columns, timestamp updates, Ctrl-C exit rc 0 with no terminal-state change). Residual flicker: the loop clears the screen BEFORE the hub fetch, so the table is blank for the fetch duration (measured 20-30ms locally on every tick; longer on a remote/slow --hub). Fix: fetch first, build the full frame into a buffer, then write ESC[H + frame + ESC[J in one write_all+flush (no ESC[2J), the same as mirror_grid's no-full-clear repaint.
